messages:
Alex (CS): kicking off Pinegrove onboarding thread — quick context: they signed 1yr committed Dedicated plan, renewal window in 11 months. primary asks: low-latency inference, VPC deployment, SSO + audit logs. want to align stakeholders + 30/60/90 milestones.
Maria (AM): thanks — looping in SE + enablement. major risk: their data ingestion teams are tight on timelines.
Jamal (SE): noted. I need to confirm model artifacts and S3 access. can someone share who owns infra at Pinegrove?
Alex (CS): @Elena - Pinegrove CTO (copied) is the technical lead. Marco (PM) will own acceptance criteria. Aisha is security.
Elena - Pinegrove CTO: confirmed, I'll shepherd infra. main constraint: we need SOC2-compliant logging and an internal audit before go-live.
Aisha - Pinegrove Sec: raising :warning: on cross-account IAM roles. prefer a temporary STS approach; will require CISO sign-off for any long-lived roles.
Sophie (Enablement): we'll prepare a 2-hour enablement workshop for devs + ops. proposed dates next Tue or Thu.
Priya (Onboard): I'll draft the onboarding playbook and runbooks. propose kickoff workshop + integration sprint plan.
Maria (AM): rough 30/60/90 proposal: week0 kickoff & infra prep, week1 integration & test harness, week3 validation & perf run, week5 pilot, week6 go-live (soft). renewal checkpoints at month 9 for risk mitigation.
Alex (CS): adding quick checklist. please react with :thumbsup: if you can own the item.

- Owner assignments:
  - Alex (CS): overall CS owner + weekly status
  - Maria (AM): contract / billing / renewal monitor
  - Jamal (SE): infra integration, model artifact validation
  - Priya (Onboard): runbooks, test cases, acceptance checklist
  - Sophie (Enablement): dev workshop + enablement content
  - Elena (Client): infra approvals / SOC2 / sign-offs
  - Marco (Client): product acceptance / success criteria
  - Aisha (Client): security approvals

Action items (short):
- Jamal: request S3 read role + sample payload by EOD Thu (4005006900)
- Priya: draft runbook + smoke tests by Mon (4005007350)
- Sophie: confirm workshop slot for next Tue/Thu by EOD Wed
- Maria: confirm billing start date and renewal trigger in system by Fri

Risks / blockers:
- Data mapping unknowns (potential delay) :warning:
- CISO sign-off on IAM could push go-live 2+ weeks if we need additional audits :warning:
- Integration with internal proxy (they use custom proxy) — SE time needed

Metrics for success (Marco/Elena to confirm):
- <10% error rate on 10k test calls
- 95th pct latency < 300ms for 512-token gen on dedicated pool
- Successful end-to-end runbook execute by client ops

Jamal (SE): I'll post a short checklist of required credentials and a sample curl test later today.
Alex (CS): nice. can we add a weekly 30-min sync cadence? Tues 10am PT?
Elena - Pinegrove CTO: Tue 10am PT works.
Maria (AM): added recurring invite, will include calendar + meeting notes doc link.
deploy-bot: scheduled recurring meeting "Pinegrove Onboard Sync" created for Tue 10:00 PT.
Priya (Onboard): starting runbook draft now. tagging owners in the doc.
Sophie (Enablement): workshop draft agenda: 1) overview + goals 2) infra walkthrough 3) dev quickstart 4) debugging & best practices.
Alex (CS): final ask — Maria, please flag any commercial risk in next update. if renewal likelihood < 70% at month 9, we'll trigger enablement escalation.
Maria (AM): noted, will include likelihood scoring and engagement plan.
Marco - Pinegrove PM: acceptance criteria look good; I'll provide sample test vectors by Monday.
Alex (CS): thanks all — will keep thread for async updates. :rocket:
